name: Raven Claw Talisman
summary: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Raven Claw Talisman is kept among relics needed to awaken sleeping druids. The sacred night elf relic is one of four Relics of Wakening used to guide the Druids of the Talon safely back from the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Key to Awakening
sections.body: The Raven Claw Talisman rests in a designated chest inside Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where Teldrassil's Druids of the Talon entered deep meditative sleep. Their hibernation is a delicate spiritual threshold. Without the proper ceremonial focus, a druid whose link to the waking world is broken may remain stranded in the Emerald Dream. Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar needs this talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting to perform the awakening ritual and bring the sleepers back safely.

sections.title: The Threat in the Barrow Den
sections.body: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting its sacred chests and sleeping druids in peril. Their desecration has cut the sanctuary off from outside aid, and the relics may be lost or destroyed. Athridas Bearmantle calls on Teldrassil's defenders to brave the den's winding earthen corridors and secure the Raven Claw Talisman before the displaced druids are lost to the Dream forever.

faq.q: What is the Raven Claw Talisman used for?
aliases: what does the raven claw talisman do
why do i need raven claw talisman
faq.answer: The Raven Claw Talisman is one of four sacred Relics of Wakening needed to rouse the Druids of the Talon from deep hibernation in the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Where is the Raven Claw Talisman found?
aliases: chest of the raven claw location
how to find raven claw talisman
faq.answer: The Raven Claw Talisman rests in the Chest of the Raven Claw, inside the earthen tunnels of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, west of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who needs the Raven Claw Talisman?
aliases: who takes the raven claw talisman
who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, needs the talisman to prepare the wakening rites for his displaced kin.

faq.q: Why can't the druids wake up without it?
aliases: why do druids need relics to wake up
can druids wake up without relics
faq.answer: Druidic hibernation involves a complex, delicate trance in the Emerald Dream. Without the Relics of Wakening to anchor the awakening ritual, a sleeper's spirit risks remaining lost there indefinitely.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how the Raven Claw Talisman reflects the Druids of the Talon's use of ritual foci to safeguard a spirit wandering the Emerald Dream.
As a night elf, you protect an ancient tradition and your sleeping kin by recovering this relic from the Gnarlpine furbolgs.
